[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Per-lane enrichment telemetry[/bold #D7AFFF]                                 [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]trace[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]trace: add a per-lane trace span and a repeatable measurement script for[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]detail-header enrichment, record the baseline in a real terminal, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]document the capture recipe so every later phase has a real [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]before/after.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]One parse per store change, not per agent[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]stores[dim] · [dim][/dim]after trace[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]skill-use log process-wide revalidating snapshot caches so N agents [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]share one parse instead of paying a full re-read each, and invalidate [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]them from the write paths.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Per-lane resolution, caching, and freshness[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]lanes[dim] · [dim][/dim]after trace[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]lanes: split the monolithic detail-header summary into independently [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resolved and independently cached lanes with per-lane freshness [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]policies, replacing the blanket 1 s whole-summary TTL, with no [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]user-visible change yet.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Publish and render lanes as they resolve[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]stream[dim] · [dim][/dim]after lanes[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]lands so the section renders partially, with stable lane order, a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pending affordance, and coalesced repaints that do not disturb hint mode[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]or scroll position.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Zero-I/O context on the first paint[/bold #D7AFFF]                           [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]immediate[dim] · [dim][/dim]after stream[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]immediate: render the in-memory commit rows and any already-cached lanes[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]on the cheap header path so SASE CONTEXT is present in the first paint [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]after selection instead of after the debounce plus a worker round trip.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]real terminal, file the named follow-ups with /sase_new_task, and close [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the epic with an honest reading of what each phase bought.[/#D7D7AF]
